name: Onyx Serpent
source:
Onyx Serpent is a mutant with the power to poison her strikes, making every attack lethal. Daughter of a member of a powerful criminal mafia clan, she quickly took control of the clan, using her cunning and strength to bend her subordinates to her will. Now, the clan is at her service, used as a weapon for her criminal purposes. Ruthless and calculating, Onyx Serpent is as feared for her lethal ability as she is respected for her ability to manipulate the shadows of organized crime.
